original_card.question: Does one selected supplier obligation follow from its actual source-bound checks?
methods: Trace one hypothesis through the source, checker and complete caller.
Construct one semantically invalid but superficially well-formed fixture and test rejection.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Pin the current sources and one obligation; the historical owner audit is an example, not evidence of a current bug.

first_step.inspect: Identify why the timing-only omission passes but the full production controller still rejects it.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one current supplier obligation and trace whether its acceptance depends on an independent check.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Closing a current acceptance gap or proof obligation strengthens reliability even without changing kappa.
allowed_variations: Audit one named current condition using a new semantic counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Reporting the historical timing-only diagnostic as a new current acceptance bug.

actual_scope: Adversarial audit of PR #2802's seven-stage increment (head 17b2ee6e) over its parent PR #2751 (head 4cfbb0cc): the retired5 stages refit5/alias5/refit5c and the retired7 stages refit7/hostmove2/alias7/refit7c (seven retired-lender aliases, two hostee moves, refits) and the FILL2751->FILL transform, checked with fresh exact code on both words: event diff, per-register occupancy timeline, forward/dual free-algebra replay plus a matrix realisation, GF(2) warp frames, refit exactness and above-floor neutrality, profile/inventory recount by two subspace representations, the 271,728-role fill with word-derived R, complete profile/mass/root, and attribution against PR #2766's pinned word and #2802's recorded retired5 evidence. The verdict extends to PR #2818 (head 175822ae), whose words/fill/order/providers are byte-identical, and covers the shared word-level base of #2824, #2827, #2833, #2839 and #2843 (their own later stages are not checked).
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one selected-supplier obligation follows from its source-bound checks. The selected supplier is unchanged. The audited object is instead the pending T74 construction of #2802 (repackaged by #2818, and the base of #2824/#2827/#2833/#2839/#2843 as of 2026-10-16 02:10 UTC): it changed two acceptance checks (R read from the providers; the A-retired-lender alias control), and its new construction had no independent check. The maintainer's T74 reviews (community-efficient1000, #1992 row) ask to separate the actual new construction from inherited ancestors.
bottleneck_link: A defect would remove the +5.38e-7 kappa margin of #2802/#2818 over #2766/#2767 and the shared base of #2824/#2827/#2833/#2839/#2843; a pass is necessary but not sufficient (T74/#1319 admission, native lowering and the PR1673 outer proof remain). It also settles the two changed acceptance checks: R is bound to the words, and alias occupancy holds for the shipped words but is a conformance property, not a kappa-soundness condition, in the finite model: no check on the pricing path reads it, and a lender's dead last write (after its last read) moved past its alias warp to the end of restore at frame FULL (C4d/C4e) still replays correctly and is identically priced, while a moved read (C4f) or a moved write the lender still reads (C4g) is rejected by both replays.
stop_rule: Publish an independent verification if S1, S2 and S5 pass, S3/S4/S6 agree and every negative control is rejected by its named rule; on any mismatch minimise a witness, post a FINDING in #2612 and ship a negative result without repair. No search; #2751's twelve-source recovery treated as a pinned parent.
evidence: verify.py --fetch: PASS_T74_RETIRED7_INCREMENT_AUDIT rules=28/28 controls=20/20 (about 2 minutes). Both words: 63 relabelled B gates = 63 declared edit pairs (alias5 35, hostmove2 14, alias7 14); 62 frame changes = 62 declared refit frames; nothing else changed; 704 register segments (632 + 72 = 639 + 65) each exactly one parent role (lenders 401/403 last act at A3175/A3174 before warps at B259/B262; 550-553/562 at B901-B910; 564/565 at B911/B912 before B941/B944); forward+dual replay over Q<free group> on 632 live inputs with 72 zero buffers and the re-derived 4547-item cleanup; 4x4 matrix realisation mod 2^61-1; 72 B warps + 24 prelude warp items with G(U)=E and U the propagated frame; refit floors 26/26, 25/32, 2/2, 2/2, the 7 above-floor refit5c frames cost-neutral; profile {1:2382,2:648,3:268,4:128,5:26,8:8}, inventory {4:26,5:2,7:62,8:78,9:240}; fill R=408 from the words, 271728 roles, idle {1:17316,3:6594,5:9878,32:1,48:26558}, FILL = FILL2751 minus 4662 roles; complete profile and mass 4816512; f(C) < 66304 < f(C+1e-24) with a written error budget. Attribution: PR #2766's own word differs from W2751 only at B1151; the other 19 frames #2802 lists with it are cost-neutral; the reconstructed retired5 state reproduces #2802's recorded retired5 endpoint 0.001717409316335491643448, local profile and fill sha256 3501f6bd...; the retired7 stages add 385667783143020379/10^24 over retired5 (the split #2802 states). Occupancy controls: a lender's last (dead) write moved past its alias warp is accepted by both scalar replays (C4a-C4e); at frame FULL (C4d/C4e) also by the frame chain, recount, refits, stage records, fill and price, and rejected only by OCC-TIMELINE plus the undeclared-edit checks; a moved lender read (C4f) and a moved write that precedes the lender's last read (C4g, A3158) are rejected by both replays and accepted by the frame chain, fill and price. #2818 identical.

open_questions.question: Does any layer outside the finite BORROW-WORD model rely on alias occupancy (no lender event at or after its alias warp)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: In the finite model no pricing check reads occupancy, and a lender's dead last write moved past its alias warp to the end of restore at frame FULL (C4d/C4e) is a correct, identically priced word, so occupancy matters only if the native lowering, physical hosting or routing treats a warp as a register hand-over point.
open_questions.first_step: Inspect whether #2802's native lowering assigns roles per register segment; if so, add a C4d-type mutant against #2802's stage-structure check and an occupancy predicate to #2818's retired7 patch check (optional regression controls otherwise).
open_questions.blocked_by: Not blocked by access: #2802's full_replay.py downloads and authenticates the 491 pinned PR2679 files and rebuilds the native providers (needs #2802's requirements.txt; author-recorded cold run 411 s); an independent check should read its outputs as data.

open_questions.question: Is the whole refit frame assignment (refit5c/refit7c, 'certified optimal') optimal under the moment cost?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A better assignment could only raise kappa; it cannot invalidate the checked value, and the seven above-floor refit5c frames are cost-neutral.
open_questions.first_step: Run an independent exact optimiser over all gates' frames with the same COPY pricing.
open_questions.blocked_by: A written objective for the #1186 optimal_frames certificate.
